reason: I'd grab the free version, snap a couple of receipts, and probably forget about it by week two like every other app I download. There's no way I'm paying $6 a month for something I haven't stuck with yet, and 10 photos is plenty for me.
objection: Will the AI actually read my crumpled receipt right, or am I going to sit there fixing every line? If I have to fix it, I might as well just not track it.
would_change_my_mind: If I actually kept using the free version for a month and it nailed my receipts and syllabus without me fixing stuff, I'd maybe pay, but only around $3 a month.
